notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1786). Words follow the engraving's spelling (quì, quà, sà, core, desir, colla, com', unaccented E for È in "E un effetto" and in Marcellina's "tutto amore e quel che fa", and "or sà" where the libretto has "non sa"; Curzio's "quell' anima" and the Count's "fremo e smania" as printed). IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions joined with ‿ only where the score sets two words on one note, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ, intervocalic s voiced. Translation literal, for meaning.
